Exercises for the lectures (drafts):

00. Lecture zero: Python, NumPy and Numba — *in preparation*
01. The pendulum: how a numerical method goes wrong — *in preparation*
02. Chaos: the double pendulum and the three-body problem — *in preparation*
03. Coupled oscillators and normal modes — *in preparation*
04. Electrostatics: the Poisson equation and large linear systems — *in preparation*
05. Heat conduction and diffusion — *in preparation*
06. Waves and the telegraph equation — *in preparation*
07. Fourier analysis: frequencies in a signal and spectral solution of equations — *in preparation*
08. The Schrödinger equation: energy levels — *in preparation*
09. Quantum evolution: wave packets, tunnelling, neutrino oscillations — *in preparation*
10. Cosmology: the expansion of the Universe and «freeze-out» — *in preparation*
11. Functions on the sphere: multipoles and sky maps — *in preparation*
12. Inverse problems: the reactor antineutrino spectrum and the SVD — *in preparation*
13. Hydrodynamics I: conservation laws and shock waves — *in preparation*
14. Hydrodynamics II: vortices and two-dimensional turbulence — *in preparation*
15. The transport equation: from Boltzmann to light in water — *in preparation*
16. Fast computations and verification: from a prototype to production code — *in preparation*
